title: Nodstage 3D: one client, start to finish
lines: I just wanted to run a design studio. Why am I spending my whole day chasing clients?
How are you managing your projects?
Projects in one app. Feedback in email. Clients on WhatsApp. Proposals in documents. Invoices somewhere else.
And you wonder why nothing stays organised.
Let's take one client, start to finish. A new enquiry comes in. It lands on your pipeline.
They book it on your booking page. Then you send a proposal with packages. They pick one and accept.
The project starts. Tasks, deadlines, who's doing what.
When the design's ready, they get one link. No account. They comment right on the work.
Like, move this slightly to the left?
Exactly. Pinned to the spot, and it becomes a task.
And when they ask for a fourth round?
Rounds past your fee become a change order. They approve it before you start.
It goes straight on the invoice. They pay by card.
Every client. It's called Nodstage. Comment studio, and we'll send you the link.
